title: BomLine
description: One component or material line in a product structure. Generic evaluation schema.

parentItemId.description: Finished good or assembly being exploded.

componentItemId.description: Child item, material, or purchased part.

quantity.description: Quantity of component per one parent unit.

uom.description: Unit of measure (e.g. ea, kg, m).

isPurchased.description: True if the line is typically bought rather than made.

leadTimeDays.description: Indicative procurement lead time in calendar days, if known.
